purpose: Primary source register. Source identity is separate from institution-specific legal applicability.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 consolidated text
sources.applicability_note: Use the consolidated text and separately record actor role, intended purpose, jurisdiction and transitional provisions. The Official Journal acts remain authoritative.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 — Digital Omnibus on AI
sources.applicability_note: Apply amendments by their own commencement and transitional provisions; do not rely on pre-amendment commentary as legal authority.

sources.title: Federal Reserve SR 26-2 — Revised Guidance on Model Risk Management
sources.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
sources.applicability_note: Supersedes SR 11-7 and SR 21-8. Most relevant to Federal Reserve-regulated banks above USD 30 billion in assets. It is risk-based supervisory guidance, not itself a prescriptive enforceable standard.

sources.title: Federal Reserve SR 11-7 — Guidance on Model Risk Management
sources.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
sources.applicability_note: Retain for historical lineage only; not the current model-risk guidance baseline.

sources.title: Guidelines on Artificial Intelligence Risk Management for Financial Institutions
sources.applicability_note: MAS states that the guidelines apply to financial institutions within the stated scope and all forms of AI technologies; perform institution-specific scope analysis.

sources.title: Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.applicability_note: ML-KEM is a key-encapsulation mechanism, not a digital-signature algorithm. NIST posted a 2025-11-17 planning note identifying an issue for future correction; check current errata.

sources.title: OSCAL v1.1.2 Model Reference
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.applicability_note: An OSCAL-oriented seed is not automatically a native OSCAL Catalog. Validate generated OSCAL exports against the selected 1.1.2 model and schema.

register_rules: Distinguish legislation, supervisory guidance, voluntary frameworks and technical standards.
Record source dates separately from effective dates.
Record jurisdiction and institutional applicability separately from source identity.
Never infer compliance or certification from the presence of a source record.
Retain superseded sources for lineage, not as current mappings.
